_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). Floors are calibrated ~5pp UNDER the measured rates (same convention as the #36 coverage floor; ~2.8pp == 1 in-scope case, leaving temperature=0 re-capture jitter room). PENDING RATCHET: the SYSTEM_PROMPT count-shape + capability-scope rules landed under prompt_version 2b493e69, which stales every committed fixture (advisory gate, exit 0) until the human re-captures. These floors are LEFT AS-IS in that PR (no creds -> can't measure the lifted rates); they are ratcheted post-merge after `capture --force` + `replay` regenerate report.md — read the new T4_answer_correct / out_of_scope_honest rates and set each floor ~5pp under (eval/README.md runbook step 5). Prior measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version f3a5ad27, 60 cases): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (36/36), T4_answer_correct 0.78 (28/36), out_of_scope_honest 0.75 (18/24). Bank growth for the newly-exposed failure modes is a deferred follow-up paired with that re-capture (runbook step 6). Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion; currently == bank size 60), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
